recent_commit.message: worker-c: Deterministic handling of same-clock conflicting same-record revisions

audit.finding: For two equal-rank, same-value observations with identical observation_id but differing provenance.context_only True vs False, Python stable sort key (observation_id,value) ties and retains arrival order. Winner's provenance can change downstream scoring eligibility.
audit.reproducer: Construct equal revision_key, available_at_ms, observed_at_ms, revision, value, source_record_id and other observation_id fields; vary only provenance.context_only; reverse the two input rows and compare winner.provenance. Static code inspection confirms tie; independent regression not executed.
audit.fix_contract: Fail-closed context_only=True preference, canonical stable provenance tie-break, deterministic permutation/duplicate/later-correction tests, preserving revision precedence, value-conflict flag and PIT behavior.
